lesson.name: Learn the Sicilian Najdorf
lesson.description: Learn the essentials of the Sicilian Najdorf with an educational video on move order, pawn structures and the key themes to know.

{How should Black fight back with a pawn in the center?} 6... e5 {[%wrong
There's a better move. Try to find it.] [%hint Advance a pawn to attack the d4
knight.]} (6... e6 $5 {This is reasonable, but it's more common to move this
pawn one step further. Give it a try!}) (6... g6 $5 {This is an OK move, but
it's not typical for the Najdorf. Try moving the e-pawn instead.}) (6... d5 $2
7. e5 {Black's knight must retreat and White is doing well. Try to find a
better move.}) 7. Nf5 {Good start! White would have been better off playing
Nb3 or Ne2. How should Black take advantage of the vulnerable f5 knight?} d5 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it.] [%hint Advance a pawn to
undermine the defender of f5.] Great job! Black takes over the center and
White can't safely capture on d5. Black is doing well.} (7... Nxe4 $5 {Black
is doing well, but there's an even better move. Try to find it.}) (7... Bxf5 $5
8. exf5 {This is reasonable, but there's a better option. Try to find it.}) *

material. Try again.}) (12... Bxb3 $2 13. gxf6 {White will win a piece. Try
again.}) 13. Ne2 {Good start! How should you save your knight?} Ne8 {[%wrong
White is winning. Try again.] [%hint Retreat your f6 knight to safety. ]} (
13... Nh5 $5 {This is OK, but there's a better knight move. Try to find it.})
14. f4 {Good move! How should you continue the pawn-storm against White's king?

there's a stronger option. Try to find it.}) (15... Bxb3 $2 16. cxb3 {White
has the bishop pair and the safer king. Try to find a stronger move.}) *

{How can White sacrifice a pawn for development and reach the famous Poison
Pawn Variation?} 8. Qd2 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it.] 
[%hint Advance the queen to defend both knights and prepare to castle
queenside if Black doesn't capture on b2.]} (8. Nb3 $5 {This is a reasonable
move, but it's more aggressive to keep developing and sacrifice the b2 pawn.
How should you do it?}) (8. Qd3 $5 {This is a good move, but most players
advance the queen just one square. How can you do it?}) (8. a3 $5 {This is a
reasonable move, but it's more aggressive to keep developing and sacrifice the
b2 pawn. How should you do it?}) (8. b3 $6 Be7 {White loses time to defend the
b-pawn and Black is better. Try again.}) (8. Rb1 $2 Nc6 {White loses time to
defend the b-pawn and Black is better. Try again.}) 8... Qxb2 {Great job! How
should you save your rook?} 9. Rb1 {[%wrong Black is doing well. Try again.] 
[%hint Save your rook and attack the black queen.] Great job! White has a
strong initiative to compensate for Black's extra pawn.} (9. Nb3 $5 Qa3 {
This is OK, but there's a more aggressive and stronger option. Try to find a
way to attack the black queen.}) (9. Qc1 $2 Qxc3+ {Black wins a piece. Try
again.}) (9. Rc1 $2 Be7 {White doesn't have enough compensation for the lost
pawn. Try again.}) (9. Rd1 $2 Nbd7 {White doesn't have enough compensation for
the lost pawn. Try again.}) *

Qxe4 {Black is doing well. Try again.}) 18... Qc5 {Good start! How should you
develop with another threat?} 19. Rc1 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to
find it.] [%hint Develop a rook and control the c-file.]} Qa7 {Well played!
